answer: New identities start with zero reputation, so a whisper of a fresh key buys no voting weight. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond that a mirror of its on-chain history must justify. Peers verify attestations against a crystal-clear ledger of prior work, and forging N identities costs N bonds plus the work to earn each score. Cheap pseudonyms lose to costly, verifiable reputation. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
